:::{#def-normalizing-constant}
#### Normalizing constant of a density

Let $g$ be a [kernel of a density](#def-kernel) $f$.
The **normalizing constant** of $g$ is the constant $c$ with $f(x) = c\, g(x)$:

$$c \eqdef \frac{1}{\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} g(x)\,dx}.$$

It is the factor that makes the [density](#def-pdf) integrate to 1.

:::
